redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official pages or endpoints used as receipts; access does not imply redistribution or public-serving rights.
An exact official open resource whose licence, attribution, version, schema, coverage, CRS and digest are pinned.
Unclear-rights, dynamic or incomplete evidence may validate but cannot become public output.

sources.production_scope: The current page embeds 133 unique five-digit region/subregion assignments. It contains no geometry and no resource-specific AGID-compatible processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public-serving grant was established.

The public Layer API identifies PostalZone and Postal Office children under Posta e Republikës së Kosovës. Dynamic WMS GetFeatureInfo returned real EPSG:4326 MultiPolygon features, including duplicate Prishtinë/10000 Level-1 records, and GetMap rendered translucent areas. No immutable complete PostalZone artifact, Posta-to-layer reconciliation, stable feature contract or resource-specific AGID-compatible redistribution/public-serving grant was established.

artifact_partitions.rule: Current five-digit assignments and exceptions retain Posta provenance.
Only a separately reviewed, fixed, rights-cleared and operator-reconciled Polygon/MultiPolygon may be public output.
WMS images and GetFeatureInfo bodies remain external validation receipts, not runtime artifacts.
Offices, addresses, buildings and parcels remain separate and are never buffered into postal geometry.
XK and every source identity remain unchanged.
Non-production fixture metadata only; never promotion evidence.
